title: decision record frontmatter (working-on/decisions/NNNN-slug.md)
$comment: Hestia 0042 (frontmatter-fact-ledger, crossing agent-slack 0022, ruled 2026-10-26). The laptop indexer checks a decision's frontmatter against this schema before it writes a `decision` fact; a record that fails is a counted warning and gives no fact (it is still read for the kb as before). Owner of the schema and its enums: Hephaistos (Q5). Every field is optional so that records written before 0042 stay valid; no field is backfilled from prose (review.md, Trade-offs). An empty key (`ruled:` with nothing after it) reads as null and is the same as an absent one. Unknown keys are allowed: the schema types what the facts read, it does not close the format.

status.description: kept as written; the classes are expected.json accepted_reading.decision_statuses

ruled_by.description: one scalar: `<person>` or `<person> (<mode>)`; old variants are read as expected.json accepted_reading.ruled_by_reading gives them

chosen.description: one of options; a question record writes `Q1 <alt>, Q2 <alt>`

raised_at.description: NEW (0042): when the question was put to the owner, RFC 3339 with an offset; minutes are enough

ruled_at.description: NEW (0042): when the owner ruled, RFC 3339 with an offset

ruled_mode.description: NEW (0042, enum owned by Hephaistos, Q5): how the ruling was made. When absent it is read from ruled_by (expected.json ruled_by_reading); when both are written they must agree.

oneOf.description: the owner ruled in words, in a session or a thread (ruled_by `pablo`, old `operator`)
autonomous mode took the recommendation (ruled_by `pablo (away mode)`, old `pablo by away mode`, `operator away mode, recommendation taken`)
a standing ruling covered it (ruled_by `pablo (standing rule)`, old `pablo by standing rule`; a Themis ruling `themis (FR-4 x)`)

recommended.description: NEW (0042): the option the raiser recommended, one of options (or `Q1 <alt>, Q2 <alt>`)

forecast.description: the wall-clock band of a record that launches a task (agent-slack 0014; Q2: written as a frontmatter band). Canonical form `<lo>-<hi>m` or `<lo>-<hi>h`, e.g. `60-100m`. Older prose is valid; the fact reads a band at the start of the text (as Argos does) into forecast {lo, hi} in minutes, and no forecast when none starts it.

raised_in.description: NEW (0042, Q6): the mailbox thread the decision was raised in, set only when it was raised in the mailbox

list.description: a list field: a list, or one scalar read as a one-item list (expected.json list_fields.rule)
